x-summary: A diagnosis with its clinical status.
title: MedicalCondition
description: FHIR Condition-flavored (not conformant) record of a diagnosed condition. Modeled loosely after HL7 FHIR's Condition resource fields — no FHIR conformance library involved (that's an explicit M3 decision, revisit if real FHIR interop is needed later). Fields below cross-checked field-by-field against the vendored priv/fhir/R5/fhir.schema.json's real Condition definition — clinicalStatus/verificationStatus/severity/bodySite are genuinely FHIR CodeableConcept fields (coding+text), not invented; the actual ValueSet code lists (e.g. condition-clinical's 7 codes) aren't encoded in that JSON Schema file itself (CodeableConcept is a generic shape) and so aren't independently verified here — same 'shape, not verified terminology'.

code.description: FHIR CodeableConcept-flavored: free text plus optional coded terms.

clinicalStatus.description: FHIR Condition.clinicalStatus's real condition-clinical CodeSystem codes, from memory — same unverified-against-the-vendored-schema caveat as verificationStatus below (CodeableConcept fields don't carry their ValueSet in priv/fhir/R5/fhir.schema.json).

verificationStatus.description: FHIR Condition.verificationStatus (real field) — how confirmed this diagnosis is. Codes below are FHIR's condition-ver-status CodeSystem from memory, not re-derived from the vendored schema file (CodeableConcept fields don't carry their ValueSet's code list in that file) — same unverified-terminology caveat.

severity.x-help: The clinician's assessment, e.g. mild, moderate, severe.
severity.description: FHIR Condition.severity (real field) — subjective clinician assessment. Free text, not a closed enum: FHIR's own binding here is extensible against a broad terminology (SNOMED CT), not a fixed short code list — mild/moderate/severe are commonly-cited examples, not the complete set, so presenting them as a closed enum would overclaim completeness.

bodySite.description: FHIR Condition.bodySite (real field) — free text, not a coded anatomical terminology (no SNOMED/similar body-site codeset vendored here).

abatementDate.x-help: When the condition resolved or went into remission.
abatementDate.description: FHIR Condition.abatementDateTime (real field) — when the condition resolved/went into remission. Date-only here, same simplification already used throughout this project (FHIR's real field is a full dateTime).

recordedDate.x-help: When this record was entered, not when the condition began.
recordedDate.description: FHIR Condition.recordedDate (real field) — when this record was entered, distinct from onsetDate (when the condition itself began).
